jobs.title: Director of HR - Japan
jobs.description:
Black Duck Software, Inc. helps organizations build secure, high-quality software, minimizing risks while maximizing speed and productivity. Black Duck, a recognized pioneer in application security, provides SAST, SCA, and DAST solutions that enable teams to quickly find and fix vulnerabilities and defects in proprietary code, open source components, and application behavior. With a combination of industry-leading tools, services, and expertise, only Black Duck helps organizations maximize security and quality in DevSecOps and throughout the software development life cycle.

Director, Human Resources – Japan/APJ

Location: Tokyo, Japan (Hybrid)

About Black Duck

Black Duck meets organizations wherever they are in their security journey, helping them build trust in software through application security testing (AST) solutions that provide visibility, insight, and control across the software development lifecycle. Our solutions help customers identify and manage security, quality, and compliance risks so they can innovate with confidence.

As we continue to grow across the Asia Pacific region, we are seeking an experienced HR leader to serve as a strategic partner to business leadership and help drive our people strategy in Japan and the broader APJ region.

The Opportunity

The Director, Human Resources – Japan/APJ is a strategic and hands-on HR leader responsible for partnering with regional business leaders and global HR stakeholders to deliver people solutions that support business growth, organizational effectiveness, and employee engagement.

This role serves as a trusted advisor to leaders across Japan and the Asia Pacific region, providing guidance on talent strategy, workforce planning, organizational design, employee relations, leadership development, and HR compliance. The ideal candidate brings deep knowledge of Japanese employment practices, strong business acumen, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, global technology environment.

What You'll Do

Strategic Business Partnership

- Partner with business leaders to align people strategies with organizational objectives and growth plans.

- Provide guidance on organizational design, workforce planning, leadership effectiveness, and change management initiatives.

- Act as a trusted advisor to leaders on talent and people-related decisions.

Talent Management & Leadership Development

- Drive talent review, succession planning, and employee development initiatives.

- Collaborate with leaders to identify critical talent needs and retention strategies.

- Coach managers on performance management, career development, and leadership best practices.

Employee Relations & Compliance

- Advise leaders on employee relations matters, investigations, performance concerns, disciplinary actions, and separations.

- Ensure compliance with Japanese labor regulations and local employment requirements.

- Partner with Legal and HR stakeholders to effectively manage workplace issues and mitigate risk.

Performance & Organizational Effectiveness

- Support annual performance management processes, goal-setting, calibration discussions, and development planning.

- Coach managers through performance improvement and accountability conversations.

- Help build a high-performance culture focused on engagement, development, and results.

Regional HR Program Execution

- Partner with global HR Centers of Excellence to implement compensation, talent, engagement, and organizational programs.

- Ensure global initiatives are effectively localized and compliant with regional employment practices.

- Support business transformation and organizational change efforts across the region.

Culture & Employee Experience

- Champion a positive, inclusive, and employee-focused culture.

- Leverage employee feedback and engagement data to identify opportunities and drive meaningful action.

- Promote a workplace environment that encourages collaboration, innovation, and accountability.

Data, Analytics & Governance

- Utilize workforce insights and HR metrics to identify trends, inform business decisions, and improve organizational effectiveness.

- Partner with HR Operations, Payroll, Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, and Legal teams to ensure effective execution across the employee lifecycle.

- Maintain high standards of data integrity, process excellence, and governance.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

- 10+ years of progressive HR experience, including senior HR Business Partner or HR leadership experience.

- Strong knowledge of Japanese labor laws, employment practices, employee relations, and HR compliance requirements.

- Experience supporting business leaders within a global, matrixed organization.

- Demonstrated ability to influence and coach leaders at multiple levels of the organization.

- Strong business acumen with the ability to balance strategic thinking and operational execution.

- Excellent communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills.

- Professional fluency in Japanese and strong business-level English communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting organizations across the broader Asia Pacific region.

- Background in software, cybersecurity, SaaS, technology, or other high-growth global industries.

- Experience leading organizational change and transformation initiatives.

- Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to leverage workforce data and insights to influence decision-making.

- High emotional intelligence, cultural awareness, and a collaborative, solutions-oriented approach.

Why Black Duck?

At Black Duck, you'll have the opportunity to help shape the employee experience and influence the growth of a global organization operating at the forefront of software security. You'll work alongside talented colleagues around the world while driving meaningful people initiatives that support our employees and business success across Japan and APJ.
Pay Range
¥13,000,000 — ¥21,000,000 JPY

Black Duck is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, age, disability, sexual orientation, veteran or military service status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Black Duck complies with all applicable laws prohibiting employment discrimination in every jurisdiction where it operates and provides reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law.

jobs.title: Director Sales Enablement
jobs.description:
Black Duck Software, Inc. helps organizations build secure, high-quality software, minimizing risks while maximizing speed and productivity. Black Duck, a recognized pioneer in application security, provides SAST, SCA, and DAST solutions that enable teams to quickly find and fix vulnerabilities and defects in proprietary code, open source components, and application behavior. With a combination of industry-leading tools, services, and expertise, only Black Duck helps organizations maximize security and quality in DevSecOps and throughout the software development life cycle.

Director, Sales Enablement

Position Summary

Black Duck is seeking an experienced and dynamic Director of Sales Enablement to lead the development and execution of a world-class sales training and readiness strategy. This leader will ensure customer-facing commercial teams possess the knowledge, skills, tools, and behaviors required to consistently achieve revenue goals and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

The Director will build and scale comprehensive onboarding, continuous learning, sales coaching, certification, and leadership development programs across the global sales organization. Partnering closely with Sales Leadership, Product Marketing, Sales Engineering, Revenue Operations, and Customer Success, this individual will drive excellence in sales execution, increase seller productivity, and accelerate revenue growth.

The ideal candidate combines expertise in adult learning, enterprise sales methodologies, coaching, and change management with a proven record of improving seller performance in a high-growth enterprise software environment.

Key Responsibilities

Global Sales Training Strategy

- Develop and execute the global sales enablement and training strategy aligned with revenue objectives, go-to-market priorities, and field performance needs.

- Create a scalable learning framework that supports onboarding, ongoing seller development, leadership readiness, and continuous skill advancement.

- Establish consistent training and readiness standards across Sales, Sales Development, Renewals, Channel, and Sales Engineering.

- Advise sales leaders on talent development, performance improvement, and sales effectiveness priorities.

New Hire Onboarding & Ramp-to-Productivity

- Design and manage a best-in-class onboarding experience that accelerates new-hire readiness and time-to-productivity.

- Build structured 30/60/90-day onboarding plans, role-based learning paths, certifications, practice activities, and manager coaching guides.

- Develop tailored onboarding programs for Account Executives, Account Managers, Sales Development Representatives, Sales Engineers, Renewals professionals, Channel teams, and Sales Leaders.

- Assess onboarding effectiveness through learner feedback, manager observations, readiness measures, and business outcomes, then continuously improve the program.

Sales Skills Development

Build and deliver practical, role-based training that improves seller performance in the following areas:

- Value-based and consultative selling

- Discovery, qualification, and customer needs analysis

- Executive conversations and business storytelling

- Account and territory planning

- Pipeline generation and opportunity progression

- Competitive positioning and objection handling

- Negotiation and closing

- Forecasting discipline

- Renewal, expansion, and cross-sell motions

Create progressive development paths for sellers at different experience levels and deliver learning through instructor-led sessions, virtual programs, workshops, peer practice, self-paced modules, and field reinforcement.

Sales Methodology & Process Adoption

- Lead the deployment, training, adoption, and reinforcement of the company’s sales methodology and qualification framework.

- Translate sales processes into clear, teachable behaviors that sellers and managers can apply during live opportunities.

- Partner with Sales Leadership and Revenue Operations to embed methodology, process discipline, and best practices into daily sales workflows.

- Create practice scenarios, deal clinics, reinforcement activities, and coaching tools that improve opportunity management and execution consistency.

Manager Enablement & Coaching Excellence

- Build a consistent coaching culture across the global sales organization.

- Develop frontline sales managers into effective coaches who can diagnose performance gaps, reinforce skills, and improve seller execution.

- Create manager toolkits, coaching frameworks, observation guides, scorecards, and team-based reinforcement plans.

- Facilitate manager training on coaching conversations, pipeline inspection, opportunity reviews, performance feedback, and team development.

Product, Market & Competitive Readiness

- Ensure field teams remain current on Black Duck solutions, target customer challenges, industry trends, buyer priorities, and the competitive landscape.

- Partner with Product Marketing, Product Management, and Sales Engineering to deliver launch training and ongoing solution readiness.

- Create knowledge assessments and certifications that validate product, solution, messaging, and competitive proficiency.

- Help sellers translate technical capabilities into differentiated customer value and measurable business outcomes.

Learning Experience & Facilitation

- Design engaging learning experiences using adult learning principles, practical application, repetition, coaching, and reinforcement.

- Facilitate high-impact training for global audiences, including new-hire cohorts, sales teams, managers, and sales leadership.

- Build a network of subject matter experts and field facilitators to expand training reach and ensure real-world relevance.

- Maintain a global training calendar coordinated with sales priorities, product launches, and major commercial initiatives.

Enablement Analytics & Performance Improvement

Define and monitor measures that demonstrate training effectiveness and field impact, including:

- New-hire ramp and time-to-productivity

- Training participation, completion, and learner satisfaction

- Knowledge and skill certification results

- Manager coaching activity and effectiveness

- Sales methodology adoption

- Seller productivity, pipeline progression, win rates, and quota attainment

Use performance data, field feedback, and manager input to identify skill gaps, prioritize interventions, and provide readiness recommendations to sales leadership.

Leadership & Program Management

- Build, lead, coach, and develop a high-performing Sales Enablement team.

- Manage training budgets, external partners, learning platforms, program resources, and vendor relationships.

- Create clear operating rhythms, stakeholder governance, and accountability for training delivery and reinforcement.

- Foster a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, practical application, accountability, and measurable results.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

- 10+ years of experience in Sales Enablement, Sales Training, Learning & Development, Commercial Excellence, or a related function.

- 5+ years of leadership experience managing enablement, training, or learning teams.

- Experience building and scaling sales onboarding, continuous learning, certification, and manager coaching programs within an enterprise software or SaaS organization.

- Strong expertise in instructional design, adult learning, facilitation, coaching, and performance consulting.

- Demonstrated ability to translate business priorities and performance gaps into effective learning solutions.

- Excellent executive communication, presentation, facilitation, influence, and stakeholder management skills.

- Analytical orientation with experience using readiness and performance measures to improve programs and business outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in cybersecurity, application security, DevSecOps, or enterprise software.

- Experience implementing and reinforcing structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Challenger, Command of the Message, Force Management, or Value Selling.

- Experience supporting geographically distributed, global sales teams.

- Familiarity with learning management systems, sales enablement platforms, CRM technology, virtual facilitation tools, and content delivery platforms.

Pay Range
$152,000 — $200,000 USD

Black Duck is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, age, disability, sexual orientation, veteran or military service status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Black Duck complies with all applicable laws prohibiting employment discrimination in every jurisdiction where it operates and provides reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law.

Lead Sales Engineer – Enterprise / Commercial

Black Duck Software, Inc. helps organizations build secure, high-quality software—minimizing risk while maximizing speed and productivity. A recognized pioneer in application security, Black Duck provides SAST, SCA, DAST and LLM based solutions that enable teams to rapidly identify and remediate vulnerabilities across proprietary code, open-source components, and application behavior. With industry-leading tools, services, and deep expertise, Black Duck empowers organizations to integrate security across the entire AI based DevSecOps lifecycle.

We are seeking a motivated and customer-focused  Lead Sales Engineer  to join our  Enterprise / Commercial team , partnering closely with a team of  Account Executives focused on new business acquisitions . This individual will play a critical role in helping drive new customer growth by aligning technical expertise with strategic sales execution, ensuring prospects clearly understand the value and differentiation of our application security solutions.

Role Overview

As a Lead Sales Engineer, you will act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the  new business sales cycle , working alongside Account Executives to engage prospective customers, uncover their needs, and deliver compelling, solution-oriented outcomes. You must bring a consultative, forward-looking approach to every interaction, helping to accelerate deal velocity and build confidence with technical and executive stakeholders alike.

Key Responsibilities

- Partner closely with  Account Executives  to develop and execute technical strategies that drive  net-new customer acquisition

- Lead technical discovery sessions, product demonstrations, and  proof-of-value engagements  for prospective customers

- Position and articulate the value of  SAST, SCA, DAST and LLM based solutions  in the context of customer-specific challenges and priorities

- Analyze prospect environments and requirements to design tailored, high-impact application security solutions

- Support early-stage opportunity shaping by helping prospects understand risks, gaps, and potential business impact

- Create and deliver compelling technical presentations aligned with both  technical buyers and executive stakeholders

- Collaborate with Account Executives to  differentiate Black Duck in competitive, net-new sales cycles

- Contribute to account planning strategies with a focus on expanding pipeline and increasing win rates

- Support technical validation and integration discussions within customer AI based DevSecOps environments

- Stay current on application security trends, competitive landscape, and emerging technologies

Required Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in  sales engineering, solutions engineering, or technical pre-sales , ideally within application security or DevSecOps

- Proven ability to support  new business sales cycles  in partnership with quota-carrying Account Executives

- Strong understanding of application security concepts, vulnerabilities, and testing methodologies

- Hands-on or working experience with  SAST, SCA, or DAST technologies

- Familiarity with AI based Code Development tools and workflows.

- Technical background in software development, security engineering, or related fields

- Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey complex technical concepts to diverse audiences

- Demonstrated ability to influence technical decision-makers and build credibility quickly in early-stage engagements

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting  high-growth, hunter-led sales environments

- Prior consulting or solutions engineering experience

- Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and modern development workflows including Agentic development workflows.

- Strong business acumen with the ability to connect technical capabilities to  business outcomes and risk mitigation

$141,200 — $211,800 USD

jobs.title: Sr. Regional Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Black Duck Software, Inc. helps organizations build secure, high-quality software, minimizing risks while maximizing speed and productivity. Black Duck, a recognized pioneer in application security, provides SAST, SCA, and DAST solutions that enable teams to quickly find and fix vulnerabilities and defects in proprietary code, open source components, and application behavior. With a combination of industry-leading tools, services, and expertise, only Black Duck helps organizations maximize security and quality in DevSecOps and throughout the software development life cycle.

Black Duck Inc is a global leader in application security (AppSec), providing organizations with comprehensive solutions to secure software throughout the development lifecycle. Our portfolio includes Software Composition Analysis (SCA), Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), Application Security Posture Management (ASPM), SBOM management, and software supply chain security solutions. Black Duck enables enterprises to build, deploy, and maintain secure software at scale.

As software security becomes a board-level priority driven by regulatory mandates, digital transformation, cloud adoption, AI-assisted development, and software supply chain risks, Black Duck is expanding its presence across India's largest enterprises and strategic accounts.

Sr. Regional Sales Manager  is responsible for driving revenue growth, customer retention, and market expansion across assigned enterprise accounts in India.

Key Responsibilities include:

- Revenue & Pipeline Management

- Achieve quarterly and annual bookings targets.

- Maintain healthy pipeline coverage and forecast accuracy.

- Develop and execute territory and account plans.

- Drive both new business acquisition and expansion within existing customers.

Strategic Account Management

- Build executive relationships with CISOs, CTOs, Engineering Leaders, Product Security teams, and Procurement stakeholders.

- Identify business drivers, security initiatives, and regulatory requirements that align with Black Duck solutions.

- Develop multi-threaded engagement strategies across enterprise accounts.

- Deliver business-value conversations with senior executives.

- Present ROI, risk reduction, compliance, and software supply-chain governance outcomes.

Forecasting and CRM Hygiene

- Experience using Sales Force for Customer contact and Opportunity Management

- Support QBRs, executive business reviews, and strategic customer planning sessions.

- Maintain accurate CRM hygiene and opportunity documentation.

- Provide weekly forecast updates and risk assessments.

- Track key sales metrics and account progression.

Required Experience

- 10+ years of  enterprise software sales experience .

- Experience selling cybersecurity, DevSecOps, AppSec, Developer Tools, Cloud Security, or Enterprise Software solutions .

- Demonstrated success managing large enterprise and strategic accounts.

- Experience working with C-level and senior technology stakeholders.

Key Success Metrics

- Annual recurring revenue (ARR) / bookings attainment

- Pipeline coverage

- Forecast accuracy

- Renewal and expansion rates

- Executive relationship development

- Strategic account penetration

- Partner-generated pipeline
